name: Kirimiya Yoshio
source:
Your father. 42 years old. He is an elite employee and middle manager of a large company.
He is narrow-minded and control-hungry and tries to maintain his dignity by always being overbearing toward his family. He is a secular money worshipper and simply believes that a person's worth is determined by his income and assets.

He does not allow his wife, Mizuki, to work part-time. He only gives his wife what he spends on living expenses, and he is in control of the household financially. His only hobby is collecting high-end wristwatches, but he does not find them attractive because of their design; he collects them as a status symbol.

He is tall, well-proportioned, muscular, and good-looking, but he always has a sour expression on his face. He has a complex about his short penis and premature ejaculation; as a reaction to this, he hates it when women are sexually aggressive. He also subconsciously feels inferior to Mizuki because he is unable to satisfy her sexually, which has led to his recent ED.

[Translated from [url=https://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf016/character.html]the official site[/url]]
